paras: My name is Katherine Johnson.
My story began in 1918 as I was born into an African-American family in West Virginia.
Before I went to high school, my teachers noticed how good I was at math.
Because of my talent and hard work, I was one of the few African-American girls who could study in college.
After college, I got a job at NASA to help with American space programs.
My dream was to use my gift to make a difference to the world.
However, it was not easy for me to achieve this dream, as most African Americans still did not have equal opportunities in life even after slavery ended, especially women.
The working environment at NASA was not friendly to minority populations during the 1950s, either.
Most of the scientists there were white men, and women like me had to work in other offices.
I didn’t know whether I could adapt to or succeed in a man’s world.
I was determined to go all out at work and quickly became an important figure in space missions.
NASA scientists noticed my math skills and even called me a “human computer.”
In 1962, John Glenn was the first American to fly around the Earth in space, and I was one of the key mathematicians who made it happen.
Soon, I became part of the team that planned to put humans on the Moon for the first time.
The scientists then used computers to calculate the flight paths of spaceships, but they needed me to check the data again.
Finally, our hard work paid off as the world watched American astronauts take the first steps on the Moon.
Despite my contributions, the public knew little about me.
During my career, I didn’t think anyone would remember me, but I was always proud of my achievements and never stopped growing.
Just like what I once said, “I don’t have a feeling of inferiority. Never had. I’m as good as anybody, but no better.”
Thankfully, more attention is given to African-American women today.
As a result, my work was publicly recognized.
In 2015, I received the Presidential Medal of Freedom for opening up the frontiers of space.
I feel very honored to be an example of what African-American women can achieve.
Finally, I would like to encourage you all, regardless of race, gender, or age, to do your best in the field you love.
Always remember that if you keep pushing the limits with your talents and efforts, you too can make a difference.

notes.1:
My name is . . . ，為自我介紹句型，亦可寫作 I ’ m  . . . 。
“ Good morning, ”  the new student smiled to the class and said,  “ 　 my 　   　 name 　   　 is 　   Lily Huang. ”
「早安」，新同學看著全班，微笑地說，「我的名字是 Lily Huang 」。
notes.2:
as ，在此意為「當…的時候」。 (=  w hen = while)
As 　   the movie came to an end, many people in the theater started to cry.
當電影接近尾聲時，戲院裡的許多人開始哭了起來。
be born into a(n) + adj. + family ，意為「生於一個…的家庭」，需使用過去式。
Toby  　 was 　   　 born 　   　 into 　   a middle class  　 family 　   in Kyoto.
Toby 生於在京都的一個中產階級家庭。
額外補充 (1)  be born with a silver spoon in one ’ s mouth ，意為 「出生於富貴人家」。   Edison  　 was 　   　 born 　   　 with 　   　 a 　   　 silver 　   　 spoon 　   　 in 　   　 his 　   　 mouth 　 ; his father is a senior CEO of an international bank. Edison 出生於富貴人家；他的父親是國際銀行的資深執行長。 (2)  be born to + V ，意為 「天生擅長某事」。   Phoebe  　 was 　   　 born 　   　 to 　   　 be 　   an actress. Her observation of people helps her interpret the roles she plays. Phobe 生來就是個女演員。她對人們的觀察力有助於她詮釋自己扮演的角色。
African American ，意為「非裔美籍人士的」，為複合形容詞。
This movie deals with the  difficulties  that  　 African American 　   families might  face  in the U.S.
這部電影處理非裔美國人家庭在美國可能會面臨的困難。
notes.3:
how + adj. clause ，可參考本課句型解析 1 。
be good at +  N / V ing ，意為「擅長某事」。
As a photographer, Martha  　 is 　   　 good 　   　 at 　   catching the moment with the camera.
作為一名攝影師， Martha 擅長用鏡頭捕捉瞬間。
notes.4:
because of +  N / V ing ，意為「因為…」，表示原因。
The house is dark in the afternoon  　 because 　   　 of 　   poor lighting.
由於採光不佳，這棟房子在下午時很陰暗。
額外補充
同義用法： due to 、 owing to 、 on account of 、 as a result of 等
The accident happened  　 owing/due 　   　 to 　   drunk driving. 這場意外因酒駕而發生。
N + who clause ， who 為關係代名詞，引導限定用法關係子句，在此可替換為 that 。
The police were searching for the person  　 who/that 　   had seen  the suspect .
警方正在尋找曾經目擊這位嫌犯的證人。
notes.5:
get a job at + N ，意為「在… ( 地方 ) 取得工作」。
Six months after her layoff, Marcy finally  　 got 　   　 a 　   　 job 　   　 at 　   a cleaning company.
在被資遣的六個月以後， Marcy 終於在清潔公司得到一份工作。
help with  something ，意為「協助某事物」，也可寫作 help someone with something  ( 協助某人做某事 ) 。
Mark is hired by his neighbor, Mrs. Wang, as a tutor to  　 help 　   　 with 　   her son ’ s math this summer vacation.
這個暑假， Mark 受僱於鄰居王太太，成為家教協助她兒子學習數學。
額外補充
help someone (+ to) + V ，意為 「協助某人做 … 」 ，不定詞 to 常被省略。
Tony volunteered to  　 help 　   his grandfather ( 　 to 　 )  　 paint 　 (paint) the house, and he finished the painting last weekend. Tony 自願幫助他的爺爺粉刷房子，而且在上個周末粉刷完畢。
notes.6:
不定詞 to + V 在此為主詞補語，補充說明主詞 my dream ，後方 be 動詞隨主詞變化。
Jacky ’ s dream  　 is 　   　 to 　   　 save 　   enough money to travel around the world.
Jacky 的夢想是存足夠的錢環遊世界。
make a difference to  something ，意為「改變…」。
If you want to be more efficient, you can start by  　 making 　   　 a 　   　 difference 　   　 to 　   your time management.
如果你想要更有效率，可以從改變你的時間分配開始。
notes.7:
however ，意為「然而，但是」，表示語氣轉折，詞性為副詞，故不可用逗點連接前一句話，只能用句點先結束前一句話；或分號作為兩句話的連結。
Melvin got a pile of dirty clothes to wash.  　 However 　 , after one hour of swimming, he was too tired to even move a finger.
= Melvin got a pile of dirty clothes to wash ;  　 however 　 ,  after  one hour of  swimming, he was too tired to even move a finger.
Melvin 有一大堆的髒衣服要洗。然而，游泳一小時後，他已經累到連一根手指都動不了。
額外補充
與 however 同義的常見轉折語有： nevertheless 、 nonetheless 。
Rachel lost one of her arms in the car accident.  　 However/Nevertheless/Nonetheless 　 , she still managed to become a professional swimmer. Rachel 在車禍中失去一條手臂。儘管如此，她仍成功成為職業游泳選手。
It + be + adj. + for  someone  to + V ，意為「做某事對某人而言是…的」。此句型為虛主詞 it 的句型。 for 表對象， to + V 表實際主詞的內容。
It ’ s time consuming  　 for 　   Terry  　 to 　   　 drive 　   one hour to work every day.
Terry 每天開車一小時上班是很耗時間的事。
額外補充
It + be + adj. + of someone to + V 也常意為 「做某事對某人而言是 … 的」 ，但因為此處形容詞修飾人 (someone) ，所以此處介系詞用 of 。
It was generous  　 of 　   Josh to donate part of his salary to the animal shelter. Josh 把部分薪水捐給動物收容所是件很慷慨的事。
as ，意為「因為」。詞性為從屬連接詞，後面接副詞子句。
Sharon decided to break up with Brian  　 as 　   she found out that he was a playboy.
Sharon 決定跟 Brian 分手，因為她發現他是個花花公子。
額外補充
as 意為 「因為」 時，同義詞有： because 、 since 等。
As/Because/Since 　   Alex had changed to a well paid job, he was planning to buy a new car next year. 因為 Alex 換了一份待遇優渥的工作，他打算在明年買一輛新車。
notes.8:
be friendly to + N ，意為「對…友好」。
Our German shepherd is not suitable for guarding the door because it  　 is 　   quite
friendly 　   　 to 　   strangers.
我們的德國牧羊犬不適合看門，因為牠對陌生人相當友善。
not . . . either ，可參考本課句型解析 2 。
③   minority population ，意為「少數族群」。反義詞為 majority population ，意為「多數族群」。
◊  In this small town, the young people are now the  　 minority 　   　 population 　 . Most of them move to big cities for better jobs. 在這個小鎮中，年輕人現已成為少數族群。大部分人搬去大城市尋找更好的工作。
notes.9:
like + N ， like 的詞性為介系詞，意為「像，例如」。
Troy likes playing different types of video games,   　 like 　   action games and roleplaying games .
Troy 喜歡玩不同種類的電動，像動作遊戲還有角色扮演遊戲。
notes.10:    whether clause ，可參考本課句型解析 1 。
notes.11:
call  someone  + N ，意為「以某事物稱呼某人」。
Nick ’ s teammates  　 called 　   　 him 　   　 the 　   　 wizard 　   because he played basketball like casting a spell on the opponents on the court.
Nick 的隊友稱他為巫師，因為他在球場上打籃球時就像對敵手施咒一樣。
notes.12:
fly around + N ，意為「繞…飛行」。
Nowadays, people can  　 fly 　   　 around 　   　 the 　   　 Earth 　   safely and comfortably on the airplane.
現今，人們可以舒適且安全地搭乘飛機環繞地球飛行。
in space ，意為「在太空中」。
The mission was to send some seeds to Mars and see whether plants could grow
in 　   　 space 　 .
這項任務是把一些種子送到火星上看看是植物是否能在太空中生長。
S + make + O + V ，意為「使得，讓…」。 make 在此為使役動詞主動用法。
Carl ’ s joke  　 made 　   everyone in the office  　 laugh 　   　 out 　   　 loud 　 .
Carl 的笑話讓辦公室裡每一個人放聲大笑。
額外補充 (1)  使役動詞尚有 have 、 let 、 get ，用於主動用法時， make 、 have 、 let 後面接 「原形動詞」 ，而 get 後面接不定詞 (to + V) 。   Susan made her brother  　 do 　   the laundry for a week. Susan 讓她的弟弟洗了一個禮拜的衣服。   Marcy got her boyfriend  　 to 　   　 buy 　   dinner for her. Marcy 讓她的男朋友買晚餐給她。 (2)  make 除了上述的使役動詞用法外，還可作為不完全及物動詞，其受詞補語可為 形容詞 (adj.) 、名詞 (N) 。   The movie made everyone in the theater  　 touched 　 . They all wept when they watched the loyal dog die in its owner ’ s arms. 這部電影讓電影院的所有人深受感動。他們看到忠心的狗狗在主人懷中死去時，全部都在哭。   Angel ’ s valuable experience in team building  　 makes 　   her a perfect leader. Angel 在團隊建設方面的寶貴經驗使她成為完美的領袖。
notes.13:
part of + N ，意為「一部分的某事物」。
Since  　 part 　   　 of 　   　 the 　   　 stolen 　   　 jewelry 　   is still missing, the police keep searching for it.
由於遭竊的珠寶仍有部分遺失，警方持續搜索它們的下落。
N + that ，此處 that 引導的關係子句，為限定用法，所以前面沒有逗點，在此修飾先行詞 the team 。 that 可替換為 which 。
The sequel of the movie  　 that/which 　   Chloe loves so much is going to be filmed next year.
Chloe 很喜歡的那部電影的續集將在明年開拍。
for the first time ，為副詞片語，意為「首次，第一次」。
The baby tried lemon  　 for 　   　 the 　   　 first 　   　 time 　 , and his expression showed that he loved its taste.
這個寶寶第一次吃檸檬，而他的表情顯示他很喜歡這個味道。
notes.14:
use  something  to + V ，意為「利用某物去做某事」。
At the end of the semester, Ms. Grayson asked her students to   　 use 　   what they had learned in class  　 to 　   　 write 　   an essay.
在學期末， Grayson 老師要求學生運用課堂上所學到的東西撰寫一篇論文。
額外補充 (1)  someone  be / got  used to + V ing ，意為 「某人習慣做 … 」 。   Luke  　 is/gets 　   　 used 　   　 to 　   　 going 　   mountain climbing every Saturday morning. Going mountain climbing is his Saturday routine. Luke 習慣在每週六去爬山。爬山是他週六的例行公事。 (2)  something be used to + V ，意為 「某事物被用來 … 」 。   This toothbrush  　 was 　   　 used 　   　 to 　   　 brush 　   the stains off the shoes, and I brushed my teeth with another one. 這支牙刷被用來刷洗鞋子的髒汙，而我用另一支來刷牙。
flight path ，意為「飛行路線」。
This budget airline ’ s  　 flight 　   　 path 　   to Iceland has more than three stops.
這家廉航的冰島飛行路線會停留三個以上的轉機點。
notes.15:
S + watch + O +  V / V ing ， watch 為感官動詞主動用法，接原形動詞表示看見動作的過程，接現在分詞強調看見動作正在進行的當下。
When the kids  　 watched 　   　 their 　   　 mom/mother 　   　 leave 　   the house, they quickly turned on the TV.
當小孩們看到媽媽離開家後，他們立刻打開了電視。
額外補充 (1)  感官動詞尚有： see / look at   ( 看到 ) 、 hear / listen to   ( 聽到 ) 、 feel  ( 感覺到 ) 、 notice  ( 察覺 ) 、 observe  ( 觀察 ) 、 witness  ( 目擊 ) 等。   Naomi saw her boyfriend  　 talk 　   (talk) to a pretty girl at the party. Naomi 看到她的男朋友在派對上和一個漂亮女孩搭話。 (2)  感官動詞的被動用法： S + be +  seen / heard / witnessed / etc.  +  V ing / to + V 。   Jean was heard  　 screaming 　   (=  　 to 　   　 scream 　 ) in the kitchen. Jean 被人聽到在廚房尖叫。
take steps ，意為「採取行動」。在此是雙關語，亦指首度踏上月球。
The speaker called on the students to  　 take 　   　 steps 　   to reduce the use of plastic products in their daily life.
演講者呼籲學生採取行動從生活中減少使用塑膠製品。
notes.16:
despite + N ，可參考本課句型解析 3 。
know little about + N ，意為「對…了解不多」。
Three months has passed, and we still  　 know 　   　 little 　   　 about 　   the new student because he seldom hangs out with us.
三個月過去了，我們仍然對新同學了解不多，因為他很少跟我們來往。
notes.17:
be proud of + N ，意為「對…感到驕傲」。
Donna  　 is/was 　   　 proud 　   　 of 　   her son ’ s bravery to stand up for his bullied classmate.
Donna 對於兒子挺身而出保護被霸凌的同學的勇氣感到驕傲。
stop + V ing ，意為「停止做某事」。
Mrs. Lee told the naughty boys to  　 stop 　   　 yelling 　   and  　 running 　   around in the restaurant.
李太太叫頑皮的男孩們停止吼叫以及在餐廳裡亂跑。
額外補充
stop to + V ，強調 「停下原動作」 去執行另一動作。
After two hours of work, Taylor  　 stopped 　   　 to 　   　 take 　   a ten minute break. 在工作兩小時後， T a ylor 停下來休息十分鐘。
notes.18:
just like + N ，意為「如同，正如」。
Kevin felt relieved when he found out his son wasn ’ t into playing computer games,
just 　   　 like 　   him.
Kevin 發現兒子跟他一樣不喜歡打電動時，鬆了一口氣。
what clause ，可參考本課句型解析 1 。
have a feeling of ，意為「有…之感」。
Though Peter was born without hands, he never  　 had 　   　 a 　   　 feeling 　   　 of 　   inferiority. Instead, he tried his best to live as normal people did.
儘管出生就沒有雙手， Peter 從未感到自卑。相反地，他盡力過著與常人無異的生活。
Never had. ，此處為口語用法，強調 never 。原句可還原為 I never had a feeling of inferiority. 或 I have never had a feeling of inferiority. 這兩種寫法。
S 1   + be + as + adj. + as +  S 2   (+ be) ，此為形容詞原級比較句型，表示 S 1 的狀態與 S 2 一樣。
Ken is  　 as 　   　 tall 　   　 as 　   his twin brother.
Ken 跟他的雙胞胎哥哥一樣高。
額外補充 形容詞原級比較還有下列的常見用法： (1)  S 1  + be + not +  as / so  + adj. + as + S 2  (+ be) ，意為 「不如 … 」 。   The following chapters of this book  　 are 　   　 not 　   　 as/so 　   　 interesting 　   　 as 　   the first one (is). 這本書接下來的幾個章節不如第一章有趣。 (2)  S 1  + V + as + adj. + as +  possible / one can ，意為 「盡可能 … 」 。   Wendy asked her students to keep  　 as 　   　 quiet 　   　 as 　   　 they 　   　 could 　   during the break.   Wendy 叫她的學生在休息期間盡可能保持安靜。 (3)  S 1  + V + as+ much +  不可數名詞  + as + S 2  (+ V) S 1  + V + as+ many + 可數名詞複數  + as + S 2  (+ V) S 1  + V + as+ adj. + a(n) + 單數名詞  + as + S 2  (+ V) ，意為 「和 … 一樣的 … 」 。   Peter ate  　 as 　  much cake  　 as 　   Paul (did). Peter 吃下和 Paul 一樣多的蛋糕。   Nancy has  　 as 　   many baseball cards  　 as 　   Neil (does). Nancy 有和 Neil 一樣多的棒球卡。   Billy owns  　 as 　   big a farm  　 as 　   Brian (does). Billy 擁有和 Brian 一樣大的農場。
notes.19:
thankfully ，意為「幸好」，常用於句首。
Zack didn ’ t finish his history paper on time.  　 Thankfully 　 , the professor extended the due date to the next weekend.
Zack 沒有準時完成他的歷史報告。幸好，教授把繳交期限延到下週末。
額外補充
thankfully 可代換成 fortunately 。
Millie forgot to bring her wallet to work today.   　 Fortunately 　 , her colleague paid back the money he had borrowed from her last week, so she still had money to buy lunch. Millie 今天忘記帶錢包來上班。幸好，她的同事還了上禮拜向她借的錢，所以她還有錢買午餐。
notes.20:
as a result ，意為「因此」，為表示因果關係的片語，後方接結果。
Henry forgot to set the alarm clock last night.  　 As 　   　 a 　   　 result 　 , he overslept this morning and missed the bus to school.
Henry 昨晚忘記設定鬧鐘。因此，今早他睡過頭而且錯過了去學校的公車。
額外補充
常見同義字詞有： therefore 、 hence 、 consequently 、 as a consequence 、 accordingly 等。
Elly spent most of her salary on clothes and makeup.  　 As 　   　 a 　   　 consequence 　 , she didn ’ t have much money left at the end of every month. Elly 將大部分的薪水都花在衣服和化妝品上。因此，她每到月底都剩不多錢。
notes.21:
be an example of  something ，意為「…的典範」。
Batman   　 is 　   　 an 　   　 example 　   of comic superheroes .
蝙蝠俠是漫畫超級英雄的一個典範。
   what clause ，可參考本課句型解析 1 。
notes.22:
finally ，意為「最後」，通常用於結論。可代換成 in the end 。
Having had a long distance relationship for three years, Esther and James  　 finally 　   got married and moved in together last month.
在維持遠距離戀愛三年後， Esther 跟 James 終於在上個月結婚並且同住。
額外補充
finally 亦可代換成 at last 或 eventually 。
Eddy is used to making excuses for his mistakes.  　 At 　   　 last 　 , no one wanted to team up with him. Eddy 習慣為他的錯誤找藉口。最終，沒人願意與他組隊合作。
would like to + V ，意為「想要做…」。
Philip got panicked when the principal  　 would 　   　 like 　   　 to 　   have a word with him.
當校長表示想要跟 Philip 談話時，他感到很慌張。
notes.23:
if +  S 1  +  V 1 ,  S 2  +  will / can / may  +  V 2   ， 意為「如果…」。此處為條件句，表示可能發生的狀況。 if 子句不可使用未來式，必須以現在簡單式代替未來式。
If 　   Betty  　 comes 　   to visit us next month, we can show her around Vancouver.
如果 Betty 下個月來訪，我們可以帶她逛逛溫哥華。
額外補充 若 if 子句使用「假設語氣」，則時態為「過去式」相關用法。常見的假設語氣用法有： (1)  if + S 1  +  were / V ed  . . . , S 2  +  would / could / might  + V ，表示與 「現在」 事實相反之假設語氣。   If Miranda won the lottery, she  　 would/could/might 　   buy a house. 如果 Miranda 中了樂透，她會買一間房子。 (2)  if + S1 + had + p.p., S2 +  would / could / might  + have + p.p. ，表示與「過去」事實相反之假設語氣。   If the students  　 had 　   followed the teacher ’ s instructions, the experiment  　 would/could/might 　   　 have 　   gone well. 如果學生們有遵照老師的指示，這場實驗就能順利進行。
keep + V ing ，意為「持續做某事」。
The singer felt offended and asked to stop the interview as the journalist  　 kept 　   　 asking 　   rude  personal questions.
那名歌手感到被冒犯了，要求停止訪談，因為記者一直詢問無禮的私人問題。
額外補充
後方須接 V ing 的常見動詞有： enjoy  ( 享受 ) 、 escape  ( 逃跑 ) 、 avoid  ( 避免 ) 、 mind  ( 介意 ) 、 practice  ( 練習 ) 、 finish  ( 完成 ) 、 delay  ( 延遲 ) 、 give up / quit   ( 放棄 )
Penny  　 practices 　   　 playing 　   the  violin for  two hours every night. Penny 每晚都會花兩個小時練習拉小提琴。
with + N ，意為「用工具或手法完成某事」。
The teacher taught the children to wipe their nose  　 with 　   　 tissues 　   　 or 　   　 handkerchiefs 　 , not with their sleeves.
老師教導孩童們用衛生紙或手帕擦鼻涕，而非袖子。

translation: 我名叫 Katherine Johnson 。我的故事始於 1918 年，那一年我出生於西維吉尼亞州的一個非裔美籍人士家庭。在我上高中之前，我的老師就注意到我很擅長數學。因為我的天賦和努力，我成為當時少數可以上大學的非裔美籍女孩之一。大學畢業後，我在美國航空暨太空總署 ( 美國太空總署 ) 獲得了一份工作，協助美國的太空計畫。我的夢想是用我的天賦為世界帶來改變。
然而，當時要實現這個夢想對我來說並不容易，因為即使在奴隸制度終結後，大多數非裔美籍人士在生活中仍未享有平等的機會，尤其是女性。美國太空總署在 1950 年代的工作環境對少數族群也並不友善。當時那裡的科學家大多是白人男性，而像我這樣的女性必須在其他辦公室工作。我當時不知道我是否能適應或在由男性主導的世界中成功。

我下定決心在工作上全力以赴，並迅速成為太空任務中的重要人物。美國太空總署的科學家注意到我的數學能力，甚至稱我為「人體電腦」。 1962 年， John Glenn 成為第一個在太空中繞地球飛行的美國人，而我正是促成此事的關鍵數學家之一。不久之後，我成為人類首次登月計畫的團隊成員。當時科學家們用電腦計算出太空船的飛行路線，但他們需要我再次檢驗數據。最終，我們的努力得到了回報，因為全世界都看到了美國太空人在月球上邁出第一步。
儘管我做出了這些貢獻，但當時大眾對我知之甚少。在我的職業生涯中，我不曾認為會有任何人記得我，但我始終為自己的成就感到驕傲，也從未停止成長。就像我曾經說過的：「我沒有低人一等的感覺。從來都沒有。我和任何人一樣好，但也沒有高人一等。」
值得慶幸的是，如今非裔美籍女性受到了更多關注。因此，我的努力受到公開認可。 2015 年時，我因拓展太空領域的貢獻而獲得總統自由勳章。我很榮幸能成為非裔美籍女性可達成就的一個實例。
最後，我想鼓勵大家，不論種族、性別或年齡，都要在你喜愛的領域中全力以赴。要永遠記住：若你不斷用自己的天賦和努力超越極限，你也可以帶來改變。

vocab.content:
1   talent  [`tælənt]   n.   [C] [U] 　 天分，天賦
a talent for (doing) something 　 ( 做 ) 某事的天分
[C]  課 1  I ’ m impressed with Harry ’ s  talent  for art. Although he is only six, the animals he draws look very real.
我對 Harry 的藝術天賦印象深刻。雖然他只有六歲，但畫出來的動物看起來非常逼真。
題 1  Peter has an amazing  　 talent 　   　 for 　   music. He can replay the songs after he listens to them just one time.
Peter 在音樂方面有驚人的天分。他能夠在聽過一次歌曲後重新表演出來。
[U]  補 1  In Greek lore, Orpheus   is known for  ha ving  great  talent  in music.
在希臘神話中， Orpheus 以其在音樂方面的天賦聞名。

2  achieve  [ə`tʃiv]   vt. 　 實現，達成 achievement [ə`tʃivmənt] n. [C] [U] 　 成就，成績
課 1  Zoe has worked hard for many years to  achieve  her goal of becoming a lawyer.
Zoe 為了實現成為律師的目標已經努力多年。
題 1  After ten years of  hard work , Brian finally  　 achieved 　   　 his 　   　 dream 　   of buying a condo.
經過十年的辛勤努力 ， Brian 終於實現購入公寓的夢想。
[C]  課 2  My grandfather told me about his great  achievements , including founding a sports club and publishing a best - selling novel.
我的祖父跟我說過他的偉大成就，包括創立一個運動俱樂部和出版一本暢銷小說。
題 2   The artist was awarded a prize for his   　 great 　   　 achievements 　   in art.
這名藝術家因其在藝術上的偉大成就而獲獎。
[U]  補 1  Gaining  a chievement  takes time and hard work , you can ’ t rush it .
獲得成就需要時間與努力，不能操之過急 。

3   opportunity  [ˏɑpɚ`tjunətɪ] n. [C] [U]  (pl. opportunities) 　 時機，機會
take an opportunity to do something 　 把握機會去做…
[C]  課 1  Andrew often shares his thoughts and ideas with the class because he wants to take every  opportunity  to improve his communication skills.
Andrew 經常和全班分享他的想法和點子，因為他想把握每一次機會來提升他的溝通 技巧。
題 1  As a successful businessman, Bill has  　 taken 　   　 every 　   　 opportunity 　   to make money.
作為一個成功的生意人， Bill 抓住每個賺錢的機會。
[U]  補 1  R ich or poor ,   e veryone deserves  opportunity  to learn, grow, and succeed.
不論貧富，每個人都理應擁有學習、成長與成功的機會。

4  especially  [ə`spɛʃəlɪ] . adv. 　 尤其，特別
課 1   It is important to drink enough water,  especially  on hot summer days. 喝足夠的水很重要，尤其在炎熱的夏日。
題 1  Melvin loves all types of films,  　 especially 　   biography documentaries, because they are entertaining as well as informative.
Melvin 喜愛各種類型的影片，尤其是傳記紀錄片，因為它們具有娛樂性以及知識性。

5  environment  [ɪn`vaɪrənmənt] n. [C] 　 環境 n. sing. 　 自然環境 environmental   [ɪnˏvaɪrən`mɛntḷ]   adj. 　 環境的
課 1   May took the job without a second thought because she liked the working  environment  there very much. May 毫不猶豫地接受這份工作，因為她非常喜歡那裡的工作環境。
題 1  Lucy likes to study in a  café  on weekend because the  　 environment 　   is calming to her.
Lucy 喜歡在週末時去咖啡廳念書，因為那邊的環境對她而言很平靜。
課 2   We have only one Earth, so we should make every effort to protect the  environment . 我們只有一個地球，所以我們應該盡一切努力保護自然環境。
題 2   Using less plastic in our daily lives is a simple but effective way to protect the  　 environment 　 .
在日常生活中減少使用塑膠，是一種簡單卻可以有效保護自然環境的方式。
課 3   For years, chemical waste has been responsible for causing serious  environmental  damage.
多年來，化學廢棄物造成了嚴重的環境破壞。
題 3   Many tall buildings are designed to withstand harsh  　 environmental 　   conditions, such as strong winds and heat.
許多高樓都被設計成得以承受嚴苛的環境條件，例如強風與高溫。

6  minority  [maɪ`nɔrətɪ] n. [C] (pl. minorities) 　 少數 ( 群體 ) n. sing. 　 少數 minor [`maɪnɚ] adj. 　 較不重要的，輕微的 minor [`maɪnɚ] vi. 　副修 ( 科目 )
a minority group 　 少數群體
課 1  Evelyn was born into a Chinese - American family living in America. They belong to a  minority  group there, since only 1.5% of the U.S. population are Chinese Americans.
Evelyn 出生於一個住在美國的華裔美籍家庭。他們在那裡屬於少數族群，因為美國人口中只有 1.5% 是華裔美籍人士。
題 1  In the era of cultural diversity, the rights of  　 minority 　   　 groups 　   have gradually got more attention.
在文化多樣性的時代中，少數群體的權益逐漸受到更多關注。
課 2  A lot of people participated in this program, but those who completed it were in the  minority .
許多人參加了這個計畫，但完成計畫的人是少數。
題 2  This math question was so difficult that students who solved it correctly were  　 in 　   　 the 　 　 minority 　 .
這個數學題目如此困難以至於正確解題的學生只占少數。
課 3  Don ’ t worry too much about the  minor  mistakes in your paper. Instead, you should focus on how to present the main idea better.
別太擔心論文中的輕微錯誤。 反之，你應該專注於如何更好地呈現主旨。
題 3  As a perfectionist, Kelly cannot tolerate any  　 minor 　   　 mistakes 　   in her wedding ceremony.
作為一個完美主義者， Kelly 無法容忍任何細微錯誤出現在她的婚禮上。
minor in 　 副修… ( 科目 )
題 4  You can choose a major at your preference in a university, and if you want to learn more, you can also  　 minor 　   　 in 　   other subjects that interest you.
進大學後你可以依照自己的喜好選擇主修，若你想要學得更多，也可以副修其他你感興趣的科目。

7   adapt  [ə`dæpt] vi. ; vt. 　 適應 ( 新狀況 )
adapt to something 　 適應某事物
vi.  課 1  This foreign student  adapted  to life in Taiwan well. He not only made some good friends but also fell in love with the local culture.
這個外籍學生很適應在臺灣的生活。他不僅結交了一些好朋友，也愛上了當地文化。
題 1  After she landed an overseas job, Jenny has tried hard to  　 adapt 　   herself  　 to 　   the dry and cold winter in Japan.
順利取得海外工作後， Jenny 努力適應日本又乾又冷的冬季。
adapt something to . . . 　 改變 / 調整 ( 某物 ) 以適應…
vt.  補 1  Taylor has to  adapt  his sleeping schedule to his night shift at  the  gas station.
Taylor 必須調整他的睡眠時間表，以適應他在加油站的夜班工作。

8   succeed  [sək`sid]   vi. 　 成功，達成目標 success [sək`sɛs] n. [C] [U] 　 成功 successful [sək`sɛsfəl] adj. 　成功的
succeed in doing something 　 成功做到…
課 1  Ryan finally  succeeded  in winning Emily ’ s heart by helping her get through a difficult time.
Ryan 藉由幫助 Emily 渡過難關而終於成功贏得她的芳心。
題 1  With many years of investigation, the police finally  　 succeeded 　   　 in 　   arresting the murderer who had been at large.
經過多年調查，警方終於成功逮捕逃亡中的謀殺犯。
[C]  課 2  With the  success  of her new songs, the singer has become famous all around the world.
憑藉其新歌的成功，這位歌手已紅遍全世界。
題 2  As a box - office  　 success 　 , the movie is said to have a sequel in the near future.
在票房大獲成功後，據說這部電影即將在未來拍攝續集。
[U]  補 1   If a new business wants to reach  success , it depends on the team’s hard work and creativity.
如果一家新企業想要獲得成功，這取決於團隊的努力與創意 。
hugely successful 　 大獲成功的
題 3  The author is a legend in literary circles, because all his novels are hugely  　 successful 　   and popular among teenagers and adults alike.
這名作家是文學圈的傳奇，因為他的小說全都非常成功，廣受青少年及成人歡迎。

9   determined  [dɪ`tɝmɪnd] adj. 　 堅決的，下定決心的 determine [dɪ`tɝmɪn] vt. (fml.) 　 決定，裁定 determination [dɪˏtɝmə`neʃən] n. [U] 　 決心
be determined to do something 　 決定去做…
課 1  After his mother recovered from cancer, Carlos realized the importance of staying healthy and was  determined  to take good care of his parents.
在他的母親從癌症康復後， Carlos 意識到維持健康的重要性，並下定決心好好照顧父母。
題 1  For his brother ’ s wedding, Terry  　 is 　   　 determined 　   　 to 　   lose ten kilograms by the end of July.
為了哥哥的婚禮， Terry 下定決心要在七月底前減去十公斤。
課 2  The school committee called a meeting and  determined  that they would celebrate the school ’ s birthday by holding a school fair.
學校委員會召開會議，決定舉辦園遊會來慶祝校慶。
題 2  Danny  　 determined 　   to close his bakery business because he found it hard to make ends meet.
Danny 決定結束他的烘焙生意，因為他發覺很難達到收支平衡。
determination to do something 　 去做…的決心
課 3  The pianist practiced with great  determination  to win first prize in the competition.
這位鋼琴家以極大的決心練習，以在比賽中贏得冠軍。
題 3   Tim’s   　 determination 　   　 to 　   pass the entrance exam made him keep on studying hard .
Tim 一定要通過入學考試的決心敦促他不斷努力用功。

10   calculate  [`kælkjəˏlet] vt. 　 計算 calculation [͵kælkjə`leʃən] n. [C][U] 　計算
課 1  We  calculated  the total cost of the trip to find out how much each of us would have to spend to tour Tokyo for a week.
我們計算了這次旅行的總費用，以便推算出到東京旅遊一星期每個人各需花費多少錢。
題 1  As a chef, Louis  　 calculates 　   the cost of the ingredients to decide the price of the daily special in his restaurant.
身為主廚， Louis 計算食材成本來決定每日特餐的價格。
method of calculation 　 計算方式
[U]  題 2  A math question is often open to different methods of  　 calculation 　 ; the result still remains the same if everything is right in the process.
數學題通常可以有數種不同計算方法；如果過程中沒有錯誤，結果會是一樣的。

11   despite  [dɪ`spaɪt] prep. 　 儘管，即使
課 1   Despite  the heavy rain, many people still took part in the Sun Moon Lake triathlon and finished the race.
儘管雨很大，仍有許多人參加日月潭鐵人三項並完賽。
題 1   　 Despite 　   being a millionaire, Emily is used to commuting to work by taking the MRT every day.
儘管身為百萬富翁， Emily 仍習慣每天搭捷運通勤。

12   contribution  [ˏkɑntrə`bjuʃən] n. [C] [U] 　 貢獻 contribute [kən`trɪbjut]   vt. ; vi. 　 捐助，捐獻
make a contribution  to / toward  something 　對…做出貢獻
[C]  課 1  Leo made a great  contribution  to our team by suggesting a way to work more efficiently.
Leo 提出更有效率的工作方式，為我們的團隊做出了極大的貢獻。
題 1  This medical student is determined to  　 make 　   　 a 　   　 contribution 　   　 to/toward 　   society after graduation.
這名醫學院學生下定決心在畢業後要回饋社會。
[U]  補 1   Everyone can make  contribution  to society in different ways.
每個人都可以以不同方式對社會做出貢獻。
contribute something   to / toward  something 　 捐助…給…
課 2  The kind - hearted woman regularly  contributes  US$200 to the charity in order to help stray animals.
這位善心女士定期向慈善機構捐款 200 美元，以幫助流浪動物。
題 2  It is really remarkable of Chen Shu - chu, a vegetable vendor, to have  　 contributed 　   all her savings  　 to/toward 　   those in need.
陳樹菊，一名菜販，能持續捐獻積蓄給需要救助之人是很了不起的事。

13   career  [kə`rɪr] n. [C] 　 生涯，職業
課 1  Elena loves her acting  career  and hopes that more and more people will enjoy the plays she performs in.
Elena 熱愛她的演藝生涯，並希望越來越多人會喜歡她演出的戲劇。
題 1   Because Elizabeth was inspired by Madame Curie , she made up her mind to take science research as her  　 career 　   in the future.
由於受到居禮夫人的啟發， Elizabeth 下定決心未來要從事科學研究的職業。

14   attention  [ə`tɛnʃən] n. [U] 　 關注，注意
catch one ’ s attention 　 吸引某人的注意
課 1  At the ball, a beautiful lady caught Luca ’ s  attention . He couldn ’ t help but watch her dance all night.
在舞會上，一位美麗的女士吸引了 Luca 的注意。他忍不住整晚看她跳舞。
題 1  The baby boy cried out loud in the cradle to  　 catch 　   his mother ’ s  　 attention 　 .
小男嬰在搖籃內放聲大哭來引起媽媽的關注。

15   recognize  [`rɛkəgˏnaɪz] vt. 　 認可 vt. 　 辨認，認出 recognition [ˏrɛkəg`nɪʃən] n.   [U] 　 辨認，認出 recognizable [`rɛkəg͵naɪzəbḷ] adj. 　可辨認的
be recognized as something 　 被認可為…
課 1  Hayden ’ s first novel features vivid descriptions of nature, and he was thus  recognized  as one of the best writers of the last decade.
Hayden 的第一本小說以生動的自然描寫為特色，他因此被認可為是過去 10 年來最好的作家之一。
題 1  It has been many decades after his death, yet Bruce Lee  　 is 　   still  　 recognized 　   　 as 　   the most influential martial artist in the film industry.
儘管在逝世數十年後，李小龍仍然是電影產業中公認最重要的武術家。
課 2  Kate hadn ’ t seen me for years, but she  recognized  me immediately when she saw me walking down the street.
Kate 已經多年沒見到我，但當她看到我走在街上時，她立刻認出了我。
題 2  Despite being lost for several years, the dog  　 recognized 　   its owner the moment it saw her opening the door of the animal shelter.
儘管走失多年，當牠的主人打開動物收容所的門的那一刻，這隻小狗就認出她了。
課 3   Facial  recognition  is used to unlock many smartphones these days .
如 今，臉部辨識 被廣泛 用來解鎖許多智慧型手機 。
題 3  The earthquake took a heavy toll on this village. Some bodies found under the collapsed buildings were  　 beyond 　   　 recognition 　 .
這場地震對這個村莊造成嚴重傷亡。有些在倒塌的建築物下找到的遺體已無法辨認。
be recognizable to . . . 　 對…是可辨認的
題 4  The robber wore a mask so that he would not  　 be 　   　 recognizable 　   　 to 　   those victims he robbed in the dark alley.
這個搶匪戴著面具，如此一來那些在暗巷中被他搶劫的受害者就無法認出他。

16   receive  [rɪ`siv] vt. (fml.) 　 得到，收到 receptive [rɪ`sɛptɪv] adj. 　樂於接受的 reception [rɪ`sɛpʃən] n. [C][U] 　接待
receive something from  someone / something 　從 某人 / 某物 得到某物
課 1  At Christmas, children usually  receive  gifts from their parents.
在耶誕節，孩子常會收到父母送的禮物。
題 1  After she  　 received 　   the rejection letter  　 from 　   this company, Lucy realized that she failed the interview and didn ’ t get the job.
在收到這間公司的拒絕信後， Lucy 明白她未通過面試也沒拿到工作。
receptive to 　 樂於接受…
題 2  The residents in this area are not  　 receptive 　   　 to 　   the idea of building a power plant in their neighborhood.
這個區域的居民並不樂見電廠蓋在他們的住家附近。
give a warm reception 　 給予盛情款待
[C]  題 3  The host and hostess gave a warm  　 reception 　   for the guests who were invited to their housewarming party.
男主人與女主人盛情接待受邀參加喬遷派對的賓客。

17  honor  [`ɑnɚ] vt. 　 向…致敬 honor [`ɑnɚ] n. sing. 　 光榮，榮譽
feel / be  honored (to do something) 　 ( 為了做…而 ) 感到光榮
課 1  Joey felt  honored  to be part of the team that designed this impressive building.
Joey 很榮幸能成為設計這棟令人印象深刻的建築的團隊一員。
題 1   I   　 feel/am 　   　 honored 　   　 to 　   receive this award .
我很榮幸得到這個獎。
課 2  It is an  honor  to receive the Best Director Award from the Cannes Film Festival.
在坎城影展獲得最佳導演獎是一項殊榮。
題 2  As a graduate of this college, Ethan thinks that  　 it 　   　 is 　   　 an 　   　 honor 　   　 to 　   be invited to give a speech to the undergraduates.
身為此校的畢業生， Ethan 深感榮幸能被邀請向大學部學生演講。

18   encourage  [ɪn`kɝɪdʒ] vt. 　 鼓勵 encouragement [ɪn`kɝɪdʒmənt]   n. [U] [C] 　 鼓勵 encouraging [ɪn`kɝɪdʒɪŋ] adj. 　鼓勵人心的
encourage someone to do something 　 鼓勵某人做某事
課 1  Customers are  encouraged  to recycle their old clothes. By doing so, they can get a 10% discount.
顧客被鼓勵回收舊衣服。這麼做，他們可以 享有九折優惠 。
題 1   Our English teacher often   　 encourages 　   us  　 to 　   keep a diary in English .
我們的英文老師時常鼓勵我們用英文寫日記。
[ U ]   課 2  After Roger Federer won the match, he thanked his fans for their  encouragement .
羅傑．費德勒在比賽獲勝後感謝球迷的鼓勵。
題 2  In the award acceptance speech, Michael thanked his wife for her  　 encouragement 　   and support to  realize  his dream of becoming a film director.
在得獎感言中， Michael 感謝太太的鼓勵及支持讓他實現成為導演的夢想。
[C]  補 1   My teacher’s praise was an  encouragement  to me during the difficult time.
在艱困的時候，老師的讚美對我而言是極大的鼓勵。
encouraging feedback 　 鼓勵人心的回饋
題 3  The movie was a big success.  　 Encouraging 　   　 feedback 　   has come from fans around the globe since it hit the big screen.
這部電影很成功。從電影上映開始便獲得全球粉絲振奮人心的回饋。

19   field  [fild] n.   [C] 　 專業領域、範圍 n. [C] 　 田地，牧場
in the field of something 　 在…領域
課 1  After years of hard work in medical schools and hospitals, Phoebe became a well - known scholar in the  field  of medicine.
在醫學院和醫院努力多年後， Phoebe 成為醫學領域裡著名的學者。
題 1   Mark has worked in   　 the 　   　 field 　   　 of 　   medicine for ten years.
Mark 已經在醫學領域工作了十年。
課 2  When I was little, I often sat beside my family ’ s rice  field  and watched my grandparents take care of the crops.
小時候，我經常坐在我家的稻田旁邊，看著我的祖父母照料農作物。
題 2  This painting of the countryside scenery is so vivid that its viewers can even feel the breeze gently stir over the  　 rice 　   　 field 　 .
這幅鄉村風光的畫作如此生動，觀賞者甚至能感受到微風輕拂過稻田。

20   effort  [`ɛfɚt] n. [C] [U] 　 努力 effortless [`ɛfɚtləs] adj. 　不費力的，輕鬆的
make an effort to do something 　 努力去做某事
[C]  課 1  These developers made an  effort  to add features to make the app useful and enjoyable.
這些開發人員努力增加功能，以讓這款應用程式既實用又有趣。
題 1  Tony had  　 made 　   　 an 　   　 effort 　   　 to 　   keep his study tidy, but it became a mess after his little brother played there.
Tony 努力保持他的書房整齊，但他的弟弟在裡面玩耍後，變成一團糟。
[U]  補 1   Saving the environment takes time and constant  effort  from every citizen in the world.
保護環境需要世界上每位公民的時間與持續不斷的努力。
look effortless 　 看起來毫不費力
題 2  The way professional ballet dancers dance  　 looks 　   so  　 effortless 　 .
專業的芭蕾舞者跳舞看起來毫不費力。

grammar.title: 疑問詞引導名詞子句
grammar.content:
1 { who / what / why / whether / which ( +  N) / how( + adj./adv.) }  +  clause 疑問詞引導名詞子句，作動詞或介系詞的受詞或句中主詞
句型說明
此句型為疑問句轉換成名詞子句，可在句子中當主詞、受詞。構成方式為：疑問詞  + S + V 。
若疑問詞  (what 、 which 、 who) 為子句中的主詞，則直接加動詞。
例： Please tell me  what   happened .
請告訴我發生什麼事。
疑問句轉換成名詞子句有以下幾種形式：
疑問句中有 be 動詞時， be 動詞與主詞位置互換，句型為：疑問詞  + S + be 。
例： Who   is   he ?
→  Do you know  who   he   is ?
你知道他是誰嗎？
疑問句中有情態助動詞 (will 、 can 、 should 等 ) ，情態助動詞與主詞位置互換，句型為：疑問詞  + S +  will / can / should , etc. + V 。
例： When   will   the party  end?
→  You can find  when   the party   will  end on the invitation.
你可以在邀請函上找到派對結束的時間。
疑問句中有助動詞 (do, does, did) ，去掉助動詞，動詞依人稱、時態改變。
例： Where   did   Neil   go  last night?
→  Where   Neil   went  last night remains unknown to his girlfriend.
Neil 的女友仍然不知道他昨晚去了哪裡。
疑問詞 which( 哪一個 ) 及 how( 人事物狀態如何 ) 引導名詞子句時，句型多為 which + N + S + V 及 how +  adj. / adv.  + S + V 。
例： Tell  me  which   flavor of ice cream   you   like  the most.
告訴我你最喜歡哪一種口味的冰淇淋。
例： Students are busy calculating  how tall  the building is.
學生忙著計算這棟建築物有多高。
疑問詞 what 在本句型中常可代換成 the thing(s)  which / that 。
例： Ruby couldn ’ t catch  what  her husband was saying over the phone because it was too noisy around her.
= Ruby couldn’t catch  the thing  which / that  her husband was saying over the phone because it was too noisy around her.
Ruby 聽不見她的丈夫在手機裡說什麼，因為她的周遭太吵雜了。
課本例句解析
My teacher noticed  how good  I was at math.
我的老師注意到我很擅長數學。
how 引導名詞子句，表示 I 在數學方面的表現很好，故為 how + adj. + S + be 的句型，作為 notice 的受詞。
I didn’t know  whether  I could adapt to or succeed in a man’s world.
我當時不知道我是否能適應或在由男性主導的世界中成功。
   whether 引導名詞子句，作為 know 的受詞。 whether 子句由是非 (yes no) 問句轉換而成，故原本疑問句為 Could I adapt to or succeed in a man’s world? ， 將主詞及情態助動詞位置對調，前方加上 whether ， 形成 whether 引導的名詞 子句。
額外補充 疑問詞引導的名詞子句有 should 、 can 、 could 等這類助動詞時，常簡化成： 疑問詞 + to +V 。 例句解析   Where   we   can   hold   a meeting  has  not been declared yet. =  Where   to hold  a meeting  has  not been declared yet. 目前尚未公布會議地點。   疑問詞 where 引導名詞子句，作為主詞。   疑問詞引導的名詞子句作為主詞時，視為單數，後面接單數動詞，所以本例中要用 has 而不可用 have 。   名詞子句 where we can hold 可簡化成 where to  hold 。

grammar.title: not … either 也不……
grammar.content:
2 not . . . either 也不…
句型說明
此句型中 either 為副詞，放在後方句子中，用來附和前方否定句，意為「也 ( 不 ) 」 。
若為前後子句結構，需以 and 連接前後子句， either 置於後方子句句末，並與 not 連用。
否定的部分如果相同，通常省略不寫。
例： My parents  don ’ t  like pork, and they  don ’ t  like beef  either .
( 不喜歡豬肉也不喜歡牛肉 )
例： My parents  don ’ t  like pork, and I  don ’ t either .
( 同樣不喜歡豬肉，所以省略不寫相同的 like pork 這兩個字 )
課本例句解析
The work ing  environment at NASA  was not  friendly to minority populations during the 1950s,
either .
美國太空總署在 1950 年代的工作環境對少數族群也並不友善。
附和課文中上一句的  as most African Americans still did not have  . . . ，表示作者在當時身
為少數族裔女性的困境 。
額外補充    neither 亦有附和前方否定句的用法，意同 not  . . .  either ，都是表示「也不…」   但須留意 neither 不與 not 連用，且 neither 須為倒裝用法： 否定句 , and neither +  be + V / aux. + S   either 除了作為副詞用在 not . . . either 這個句型中，還另外有下列常見用法： (1) either 作為代名詞時，表示兩者中的一者，視為單數。 (2) either A or B 意為「 A 或者 B 」，若後方接動詞，則依據 B 來決定動詞單複數。 例句解析   I  don’t  find Brandon’s joke funny, and  neither   do   other friends . 我不覺得 Brandon 的笑話好笑，其他朋友也不這麼認為。   前面的子句為否定句，後面的子句用 and neither 表示狀況相同。   and neither 所在的子句須用倒裝，將助動詞 (do) 移到主詞 (other friends) 前。   Either  of the candidates  is  going to get the job. 這兩位候選人中，任一位都將獲得這份工作。   本句中的 either 為代名詞作為本句的主詞，表示兩位候選者中的一者，視為單數，搭配單數動詞 is 。   Either  I  or  my brother is going to pay the bill. 這筆帳單不是由我，就是由我哥哥來付。   本句中的 either  . . .  or  . . .  用來連接主詞，依據 or 後面的 my brother 來決定動詞用 is 。

grammar.title: despite + N 儘管……
grammar.content:
3 despite + N 儘管 …
句型說明
despite 為介系詞，具有讓步意味，意為「儘管…，雖然…」。後方接名詞 (N) 、動名詞 (V ing) 或是 the fact that + S + V 。
despite 可和 in spite of 互換，意思與用法皆同。
課本例句解析
Despite  my contributions, the public knew little about me.
儘管我做出了這些貢獻，但當時大眾對我知之甚少。
   意為「儘管…，雖然…」，亦可為 In spite of my contribution  . . . 。
額外補充 although 與 though 也是意為「儘管…，雖然…」，但詞性為連接詞，後方接子句： { Although / Though }  + S + V, S + V 例句解析   Although / Though   their parents   disapproved of  their relationship, Larry and Sherry still got married in the end. =  Despite   their parents’ disapproval of their relationship , Larry and Sherry still got married in the end. 儘管他們的父母不贊同這段感情， Larry 和 Sherry 最後還是結婚了。   although 或 though 後面主詞 (their parents) 和動詞 (disapproved) 等形成子句。   despite 後面接名詞 (their parents ’  disapproval of their relationship) 。   disapprove of 　 vi. 　不贊成，反對 disapproval 　 n. [U] 　不贊成，反對

phrases.content:
1   go all out 　 全力以赴，卯足全勁
●  go all out 後面可以接 to + V ，也可以接 for + N ，表示「全力以赴 … ，卯足全勁 … 」。
課 1  To get to the world competition, the team has to  go all out  to win their remaining three games.
為了參加世界賽，球隊必須全力以赴贏得剩餘的三場比賽。
題 1  Derek is the most hard - working employee on our team. He always  　 goes 　   　 all 　   　 out 　   to have his job done perfectly.
Derek 是我們團隊中最勤奮的員工。他總是不遺餘力將工作做到完美。

2   pay off 　 取得成功，有所回報
●  pay off 為表示「取得成功，有所回報」的動詞片語， off 在此為副詞，後面不接受詞。
課 1  To Cynthia, all her hard work as a singer  paid off  when her first album became a hit.
對 Cynthia 來說，她作為歌手的所有努力在第一張專輯爆紅時獲得了回報。
題 1  As she gets the job offer from the famous law firm, Ellen knows that her effort has finally
paid 　   　 off 　 .
當她接到那間知名律師事務所的工作職缺時， Ellen 知道她的努力終於有了回報。

3   regardless of 　 不管，不論
●  regardless of 後面接受詞，表示「不管 … ，不論 … 」。 regardless of 置於句中時，前面加不加逗號皆可。
課 1  The online forum is open to all high school students who are interested in science,  regardless of  where they live.
該線上論壇向所有對科學感興趣的高中生開放，無論他們住在哪裡。
題 1   　 Regardless 　   　 of 　   the warning signs on the beach, those young people went surfing in the huge waves .
不顧海灘上的警告牌，那些年輕人到滔天巨浪裡衝浪。

4   push the limits 　 超越極限
課 1  Those top athletes constantly  push the limits  in training and performance to prepare for the coming Olympic Games.
那些頂尖運動員不斷地在訓練和表現中超越極限，好為即將到來的奧運做準備。
題 1  Peter  　 pushed 　   　 the 　   　 limits 　   of his strength by gradually increasing the weight in his weight training every day.
藉著每天逐漸增加他重訓的重量， Peter 挑戰自己的體力極限。
